# gramlot-js-server 0.3.30 — collections a page declares

- The Node/Bun server and the serverless exports serve and export only the collections of the page graph, read from `collectionAssets()` of the core. A page that declares `typst` in `gramlots` gets it; the others do not.
- Single-file export of the quick start: 66.1 MB → 18.4 MB.
- The serverless window bundle leaves out `big.js` and `@xmldom/xmldom`; the Worker keeps xmldom.
- Requires @gramlot/gramlot 0.3.35: 0.3.29 imports `standardCollectionAssets()`, which core 0.3.35 renamed to `collectionAssets()`.

Qualification: full test suite green on GitHub Actions (Node and Bun, serverless exports and gallery in Chromium).
